newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Technical fault halts Singapore share trades.
newsitem.headline: Technical fault halts Singapore share trades.

text.p: A technical fault halted trade on the Stock Exchange of Singapore on Monday morning, an exchange official said.
The official said trading was interrupted shortly after the market opened at 0100 GMT and the cause of the fault remained unknown.
Prior to the system failure, the benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index was trading down 0.64 points at 2,018.96. Turnover was a meagre 3.4 million shares.
Some dealers said they were taking the opportunity to watch the Malaysian stock market and spend time chatting with clients.
